name: The majority voted against a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2017-09-07.8.8) to agree with the bill's main idea. In parliamentary jargon, they voted against reading the bill for a second time. This means the bill failed and will no longer be considered in Parliament. ### What was the bill's main idea? The [bill](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/s1085) was introduced "*to remove goods and services tax from the supply of electricity.*"
